purpose: Manifest of language packs (§53 Stage 2 — proof of engine reuse). A pack makes a language BETA (starter reference content) — never PRODUCTION. PRODUCTION requires a full reviewed course (lessons + practice + quiz + review) passing QA in real Chromium; today only Hindi has that.
policy: PRODUCTION = full course with browser QA. BETA = authored starter pack rendering through the shared engines. PLANNED = registered language with no authored content yet.

packs.scope: starter pack — vocab + phrases + grammar reference; no lesson pages, no audio, no quizzes
